fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for the bug that a conductor run's check can record an empty findings round with no evidence and pass. Research: runCheckFindings in internal/api/run_review.go accepts any empty list; checks are identified only by free-form names (plan, code, qa in ship-change); workflow.Step.Conducts() marks an agent step declaring checks. The planner asked one design question (how to refuse a shallow round); there was no owner, and the arbiter ruled in Decision shallow-round-needs-leaf-coverage: in a conductor step every leaf must be covered by a finding naming it or a non-blank evidence line, else run findings --check refuses and journals nothing; evidence is journaled and shown by run status; classic checks steps and plan review unchanged; the check guides write one evidence line per acceptance point. The plan splits this into the refusal in run findings, run status showing the lines, the conductor testscript fixtures, and the guides. The change set serves m36-conductor.
fields.title: Plan of Fix Shallow checks pass (autonomous plan run)
